newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-LEHMAN AND FALDO LINE UP FOR WORLD INVITATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-LEHMAN AND FALDO LINE UP FOR WORLD INVITATIONAL.

text.p: British Open champion Tom Lehman of the United States and Englishman Nick Faldo, the U.S. Masters champion, head the line-up for the 800,000-pound ($1.3-million) World Invitational at the Loch Lomond Golf Club in Scotland in July.
South Africa's Ernie Els, U.S. Open winner Steve Jones and European number one Colin Montgomerie of Scotland will also use the event to warm up for the British Open at Royal Troon the following week.
The event, which carries Ryder Cup qualifying status, takes place from July 9 to 12.
Last year's inaugural World Invitational at Loch Lomond was won by Thomas Bjorn of Denmark.
